privacy: Do not place private text, search terms, credentials or source proofs in Bundle/logs/screenshot fixtures. Reuse existing secure owners; display preferences contain only nonsensitive options.
backOrder: Platform IME handling first when keyboard owns Back
Topmost owned modal/editor with its cancel/draft rules
Detail back to originating route anchor
focus: Restore only a still-existing trigger in the same active navigation generation. If removed or invalidated, use a stable page heading/list target; never revive stale source content.

contracts.submit: Allow valid text OR ready image/audio; prevent duplicate mutation
contracts.success: Repository confirms original and required attachments; clear committed draft only
contracts.cancel: Keep draft according to existing secure persistence contract
contracts.failure: Keep body/attachments; state partial attachment failure accurately

contracts.enter: Record ID and current revision plus separate edit draft
contracts.success: New original revision; invalidate old derived content as existing rules require
contracts.cancel: Distinguish keep draft from explicitly discard edits
contracts.failure: Conflict or source invalidation cannot silently overwrite original

contracts.enter: Title, date, time, zone and reminder option form one draft
contracts.success: Clear draft only on committed task
contracts.cancel: Retain session draft; explicit clear separate; cross-process persistence must be designed, not implied
contracts.failure: Keep every input and selected precision

contracts.submit: Apply atomically replaces applied filters; preserve query
contracts.success: Real repository results, no empty date headings
contracts.failure: Error is distinct from no matches
cases: focus changes do not move tapped controls

contracts.owner: Existing navigation generation and source/version validators
contracts.enter: Capture originating route and list anchor
contracts.success: Back returns to originating result/task/question position
contracts.failure: Deleted, revoked or stale source is unavailable, not replaced by current text

contracts.submit: Persist completion and existing reminder cancellation intent
contracts.success: Completed after acknowledgement; explicit undo uses real reopen semantics
contracts.cancel: Do not treat interrupted animation as cancellation of business mutation
contracts.failure: Keep or restore previous state; no disappearing failed task

contracts.submit: Show title, timing, source and reminder choice; explicit confirm only

contracts.success: UI follows real duration and progress
contracts.failure: Missing/corrupt source and focus loss produce truthful state

contracts.cancel: Closing picker does not undo already persisted choice
contracts.failure: Show save-unconfirmed state; unknown data never broadens policy

contracts.submit: Validate version, integrity, scope and admission before restore
contracts.cancel: Respect existing rollback and cleanup contract
contracts.failure: Password, corruption, space and interruption distinct; no false success

contracts.success: Original excerpts, tags and resolvable sources; not AI summary
contracts.cancel: Return to prior route without lost position
contracts.failure: Changed/deleted source is not silently kept valid

contracts.success: Lock and generation invalidate old private views
contracts.cancel: No authorization inferred from navigation or visuals
contracts.failure: No private content fallback after storage/key failure

insets: Reuse consumed Scaffold padding and existing IME ownership; do not add duplicate navigation/IME padding. No fake status bar or phone frame in APK.

acceptanceLayers.compose: State transitions, enabled/selected semantics and route ownership
acceptanceLayers.emulator: Actual storage, system insets and navigation execution
acceptanceLayers.physical: Chinese composing IME, TalkBack reading/focus, real microphone, OEM delivery and performance

stopConditions: A migrated route loses an existing capability or source guard
A visual state reports success before repository acknowledgement
Unknown destructive restore requires real user data
Native design claims rely only on browser screenshot
